Binding rule: Semantic similarity generates candidates only; it never creates authority.
A mapping becomes authoritative only through explicit registry approval with rationale/evidence.
FUTURE/HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED authority cannot satisfy ACTIVE release scope.
Missing mapping = TRACEABILITY-PENDING and blocks affected release behavior.
C4/C5 mappings require invariant + test oracle before release.
Critical asynchronous mappings require reconciliation owner + recovery path.
High-impact AI requires AI-TASK + Safety Envelope + human-authority boundary.
Unknown/missing/conflicting/unsupported states cannot map to reassuring clinical states.
One PROD requirement may map to multiple ENG requirements and vice versa; mappings are many-to-many.
Section mapping does not automatically approve every atomic requirement beneath it.
Historical ANNEX-PARITY cannot be used as active mapping authority.
Any conflict between approved mappings and master authority is BLOCKED: SPEC_CONFLICT.
